en.title: Mainland China Considers New Disability Education and Accessibility Laws
en.summary: Mainland China is researching improvements to disability education law and plans to promulgate an accessible environment construction law. Meta may place accessibility features behind a paywall on its Glasses, potentially benefiting Apple if it offers them free, while major OTTs are urged to prioritize captions and audio description. Research shows youth disability inequity unchanged, transport adds hearing‑impaired driver signs, and social media discusses ableism in anime.

zh-TW.title: 內地研究完善殘疾人教育法 規劃無障礙環境建設法
zh-TW.summary: 內地正研究完善殘疾人教育等法制，計劃出台無障礙環境建設法。Meta 可能將其眼鏡的某些無障礙功能設置為付費牆，這可能讓 Apple 在免費提供類似功能時獲得優勢。主要 OTT 平台被呼籲優先提供字幕、聲音描述及使用者介面改進，研究顯示殘疾青年不平等程度未改變，交通部推出聽障駕駛識別標識，社群討論則關注動畫中的能力主義。
